findings.title: Preserve the light-theme contrast of expanded-post attribution links
findings.body: The light-theme branch changes expanded-post attribution links from scaling $primary by 30% to scaling it by 70%, rather than preserving the existing color. With a black primary color this changes the text from approximately #4d4d4d to #b3b3b3 on a light background, substantially reducing readability for these small (0.929em) links. Keep the light branch at 30% and use the complementary 70% secondary scale for the dark branch.
